items.title: Firefox reunites Numa Numa Guy, Chocolate Rain and Bad Luck Brian
items.summary: Firefox's "Come Back to Firefox" ad, which debuted during Sunday Night Football, reunited early-internet meme stars and ended with the whole cast doing the Numa Numa dance. Commenters called it "The Avengers for chronically online millennials."
items.author: @firefox

references.title: Firefox reunites meme royalty to remind you what the internet used to feel like

post.name: Firefox
post.text:
How is the internet less private than in 2006, when the whole family shared one computer?

Back then, the internet was weird, personal, and all of ours.

So, we got your favorite meme legends back together to say it louder:  What happened to the internet? 1/3
